events.title: New Deployment System, Keyboard Shortcuts, Compass & Continuous Alpha Testing
events.summary: Today brings a major update to War Company, introducing a new deployment order system, keyboard shortcuts for issuing commands, and a new compass ribbon to improve map orientation.This update also marks an important step forward for the demo as it moves toward more active, ongoing playtesting. events.title: Latest Update: Armor Crews and Order Control Changes
events.summary: This update brings important changes, fully crewed tanks, and the first steps on control improvements.Order Controls — A New Way to Issue CommandsThe latest patch offers some flexibility in how orders are issued, giving you more control over how your units carry out their tasks.New orders replace existing orders by default. Issuing a new order will replace the unit's current order set unless you hold Shift.Hold Shift to queue orders. This allows you to append new orders to the existing order set

events.title: PatchFest Updates!

events.title: Environment Overhaul update for the Demo!
events.summary: I've just pushed a major environment overhaul, updating almost all of the nature assets in the demo. While it's not aiming for AAA-level visuals, the goal is to create a more immersive atmosphere while still leaving a little room for imagination.Thank you all for the continued feedback and support! I'm paying close attention to what players are saying, and I'll do my best to prioritize the changes that align with the community's overall feedback.I'm also leaning toward delaying the full release

events.title: Demo Updates!
events.summary: Thanks to all the feedback and reports from the demo launch! I've been pushing updates quickly over the past couple days and wanted to document them for clarity. This biggest issue is that some users had Mouse control/DPI issues on Windows. The new build starts the game up in Fullscreen Windowed (borderless) mode to sidestep this issue.
